meta.author: Sudan Geopolitical Analyst
meta.conventions: point/low/high summarise the era; see range_kind for what the range means. Each figure in estimates[] carries its own year, territory, method, sources and badges. Badges: CENSUS, MODEL, CONTESTED, SINGLE-SOURCE.

not_used.McEvedy & Jones 1978: Not accessible legitimately from the box (no licensed copy); not quoted from memory.
not_used.HYDE 3.3 grids: Direct aggregation over Sudan borders not feasible (download portal bot-walled); country series via OWID used instead.

POP_WPP2024.title: World Population Prospects 2024, Total Population by Sex (CSV, Medium/Low/High and probabilistic variants)
POP_WPP2024.author: UN DESA, Population Division
POP_WPP2024.note: Latest release reachable on 2026-10-24 (no WPP2026 CSV found). Values are 1 July, thousands; Sudan LocID 729, South Sudan LocID 728, current borders; former Sudan = sum.

POP_LAVERGNE1994.title: Quelques aspects de l'évolution démographique du Soudan 1956-1993
POP_LAVERGNE1994.author: Marc Lavergne
POP_LAVERGNE1994.note: Gives national census totals 1/1/1956 10.263 M, 3/4/1973 14.819 M, 14/2/1983 20.594 M, 15/4/1993 24.941 M (provisional, northern states).

POP_ALIAHMED_UNSD.title: The Fifth population census in Sudan: a census with a full coverage and a high accuracy
POP_ALIAHMED_UNSD.author: A.H. Ali Ahmed (Neelain University, ex-director CBS)
POP_ALIAHMED_UNSD.note: Section 1 Background: 1955/56 enumerated 10.1 M adjusted to 10.3 M; 1973 preliminary 12.3 M adjusted to 14.8 M after PES; 1983 20.6 M adjusted to 19.1 M; 1993 24.9 M adjusted to 25.9 M, rural South not covered. Year of paper not printed; 2009 inferred from content (VERIFY).

POP_ILO_SSM5.title: Sources and Methods, Vol. 5: Population Censuses – Sudan
POP_ILO_SSM5.author: ILO Department of Statistics
POP_ILO_SSM5.note: 1993 census held 15 April; three southern regions only partially covered; final tabulation June 1995.

POP_CBS2008.title: 5th Sudan Population and Housing Census 2008: Priority Results (submitted to the Population Census Council)
POP_CBS2008.author: Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) & SSCCSE

POP_ST2009_RESULTS.title: Sudan announces details of contested census results
POP_ST2009_RESULTS.author: Sudan Tribune

POP_ST2009_REJECT.title: South Sudan parliament throws out census results
POP_ST2009_REJECT.author: Sudan Tribune
POP_ST2009_REJECT.note: 7 July 2009: Southern Sudan Legislative Assembly declares 2008 results null and void; GoSS cabinet rejected them days earlier (sudantribune.com/article/31571).

POP_HRW2004_APPA.title: Darfur Destroyed, Appendix A: Population of Sudan: Ethnic Census of 1956
POP_HRW2004_APPA.author: Human Rights Watch
POP_HRW2004_APPA.note: Quotes the 1955/56 census grouping shares (597 tribes in 56 tribal groups). Primary: Republic of Sudan, First Population Census of Sudan 1955/56, Final Report vol.3 (1962) — not accessed by us.

POP_HYDE33.title: History database of the Global Environment (HYDE) 3.3
POP_HYDE33.author: K. Klein Goldewijk et al., Utrecht University / PBL
POP_HYDE33.note: Gridded/country tables not downloadable from the box (geo.public.data.uu.nl behind a bot wall on 2026-10-24); country values read via POP_OWID_POP, which uses HYDE v3.3 for 10,000 BCE–1799.

anglo-egyptian-sudan-condominium.range_kind: spread between sources at era end (WPP 1950 vs census 1956)

former Sudan (Anglo-Egyptian Sudan; incl. present South Sudan)
estimates.method: 1955/56 First Population Census, adjusted national total (sample enumeration used in parts of the South and for scattered nomads)
estimates.caveat: Enumerated ~10.1 M, adjusted to ~10.3 M; coverage in the South and among nomads relied on chiefs and sampling.

ethnic_shares.basis: 1955/56 census grouping of 597 registered tribes into categories (census-defined, self-chosen tribe)
ethnic_shares.caveat: Read from HRW quotation of the census, not the Final Report itself; categories are the census's own and crude.

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.territory: former Sudan to 2011; Sudan only from July 2011
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.range_kind: spread of estimates across the era

estimates.territory: northern states + partial South (rural South not enumerated)
estimates.caveat: Not a national count: rural southern areas omitted (war); nomads under-covered (3% vs 11% in 1983); some overcount for ration purposes. Adjusted later to 25.9 M.

estimates.method: Fifth census (22 Apr–6 May 2008), priority results Table T01
estimates.caveat: Rejected by the GoSS and Southern Sudan Legislative Assembly (July 2009) as undercounting the South and southern IDPs in the North; Darfur and nomad growth disputed. North figure = total minus South.

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.note: Era straddles the 2011 secession; figures before and after are not comparable territories.

republic-of-south-sudan.range_kind: point = WPP 2024 Medium for 2024; low/high = 80% PI for 2026
republic-of-south-sudan.caveat: No census since 2008; large refugee and returnee flows.

december-revolution-transition.note: No census since 2008; WPP is a projection from 2008 base plus surveys.

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.range_kind: point = WPP 2024 Medium for 2024; low/high = WPP 80% prediction interval for 2026
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.caveat: De jure modelled population; war deaths, refugee outflows and internal displacement since April 2023 are not measured and may not be fully reflected. Not a count of people present.
